content:
Is there currently a way to (painlessly) define the scaled inner product space from an existing inner product space (where the inner product is scaled by a positive constant). Ultimately I would like this so I can define a weighted inner product space on a finite Pi of inner product spaces, but this could be done with PiLp if the former could be done.

If this is not currently possible I would appreciate guidance from those familiar with this part of the library on what the best approach to developing the necessary API would be.

I would guess you want a new WithScaledMetric c X type synonym, which inherits the topology and uniform space and algebraic structure from X, but scales the (e)metric / norm / inner product structures.
This wouldn't be particularly painless, but you could suffer the pain once and PR it to mathlib
If possible could you also support multiplying by ∞, for EMetricSpace?
